notes: Multi-city FAN EXPO HQ brand; this show is close enough (3 months out) that its celebrities page is a real 2027 announcement ('THE STARS OF SUPERNATURAL' -- Jared Padalecki, Mark Sheppard, Mark Pellegrino, Jim Beaver, Ruth Connell -- plus Adam Savage), unlike its sister cities. Cover uses the 'MEET YOUR HEROES' homepage carousel photo of Jared Padalecki (one of the confirmed guests) signing at a FAN EXPO table, the only edition-relevant photo found; the plain header image is a repeating text pattern and the og/logo are generic. Refute pass (2026-10-05): a fresh re-extraction confirms edition-specific proof for every guest -- the Supernatural five (Padalecki, Sheppard, Pellegrino, Beaver, Connell) are named in an on-page announcement graphic filed as 'FXNO27-Supernatural-Cast-Annou...' linking to store.epic.leapevent.tech/fan-expo-new-orleans/2027, and Adam Savage has his own photo-op purchase link at .../fan-expo-new-orleans/2027/adam-savage -- so all six resolve to this specific 2027 edition, not a template date; lineup upheld.
